```lean
theorem lg_target {α : Type u_2} [LinearOrder α] [One α] [Sub α] [PredSubOrder α] {b : α} (hb : ¬IsMin b) : Set.Iic (b - 1) = Set.Iio b := by
  apply Set.ext
  intro x
  constructor
  · rw [Set.Iic_eq_Iio_iff.1 (Iic_le_Iio hb)]
    exact (Sub.sub_le_iff' (PredSubOrder.pred_sub_order b)).1 (Iic_subset_Iio hb)
  · rw [Set.Iio_eq_Iic_iff.1 (Iio_le_Iic hb)]
    exact (Sub.le_sub_iff' (PredSubOrder.pred_sub_order b)).2 (Iio_subset_Iic hb)
```
